title: Concept: Dependency declared with a multi-segment wildcard
description: package.json declares a multi-segment wildcard that accepts every version of every major, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration is unbounded in every segment, so the install follows whatever the registry publishes next, including a compromised release.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration is unbounded in every segment, so the install follows whatever the registry publishes next, including a compromised release.
